notes.scope: weather_impact_summary and air_quality_impact_summary keep only environment_in_scope (NYC) trips, the population of Q2-Q4; daily_mobility_summary and taxi_zone_statistics keep every trip, like Q1/Q5/Q6.
notes.weather_category: Labels come from configs/analytical_queries.json through dic_pipeline.queries.integrated_weather_category_sql, the same CASE expression Q2 renders.
notes.pm25_bins: The air product stores the hourly PM2.5 value; role B's descriptive bands are applied at query time.
notes.zero_demand_hours: Products store observed hours only. Q3-Q5 pad zero-demand hours from the validated Taxi coverage calendar (configs/datasets.json) at query time.
